body.p: AMENDMENT AND RESPONSE UNDER 37 C.F.R. § 1.111 Page 6

p.u: Title: GAIT-BASED ASSESSMENT OF NEURODEGENERATION REMARKS

body.p: This communication responds to the Non-Final Office Action dated September 30, 2024.
Claim 9 is presently amended to add an inadvertently omitted phrase that can be found in claim 18; no new matter has been added. Claims 1-20 are pending in this application.
Applicant notes with appreciation the Examiner's indication of allowability of all claims subject to the filing of a Terminal Disclaimer.
Claims 1-20 were rejected on the ground of non-statutory double patenting as being

unpatentable over claims 1-15 of U.S. Patent No. 11,986,286. Applicant does not admit that the claims are obvious in view of U.S. Patent No. 11,986,286. However, a Terminal Disclaimer in compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 1.321 is enclosed herewith to obviate these rejections.

It is respectfully submitted that the claims are in condition for allowance, and notification to that effect is earnestly requested. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at (612) 373-6900 to facilitate prosecution of this application.
If necessary, please charge any additional fees or deficiencies, or credit any overpayments to Deposit Account No. 19-0743.
SCHWEGMAN LUNDBERG & WOESSNER, P.A. P.O. Box 2938
